heading: License Suspension & Remediation Flow
subheading: Structured compliance workspace for reviewing Bureau of Indian Standards suspension orders, immediate directives, and submitting verifiable CAPA remediation packages.

workflow.title: Structured 6-Step Remediation Workflow
workflow.step1Desc: Review official grounds, findings, and statutory directives issued by the BIS Branch Office.
workflow.step2Desc: Examine relevant standard clauses under IS 14543:2018 requiring corrective engineering.
workflow.step3Desc: Verify conformity benchmarks and root causes in the SAATHI Gap Analysis tool.
workflow.step4Desc: Prepare mandatory Root Cause Analysis (RCA), calibration proof, and replacement batch test reports.
workflow.step5Desc: Furnish authorized signatory declaration and dispatch the complete digital remediation dossier.
workflow.step6Desc: Monitor BIS scrutiny milestone progress and reinstatement order status.
workflow.rcaPlaceholder: Detail technical root cause (e.g., winding enamel pinhole, stator potting gap)...
workflow.correctivePlaceholder: Detail manufacturing process modifications and tooling upgrades...
workflow.preventivePlaceholder: Detail new in-line inspection gates and automated HV testing checks...
workflow.declarationText: I hereby certify under penalties of statutory perjury that the corrective measures described have been implemented in the manufacturing plant and all statements are true and verifiable by BIS inspecting officers.
workflow.statusSubmitted: Remediation Package Under Review by BIS Technical Scrutiny Officer
